name: php-namespace-tools
description: PhpStorm-style completion: reuse an existing namespace import as a prefix instead of adding a new use statement.

commands.title: PHP Namespace Tools: Debug Workspace Symbols

phpNamespaceTools.enabled.description: Offer relative-namespace completions in PHP files.

phpNamespaceTools.minimumPrefixLength.description: Minimum characters typed before the workspace symbol index is queried.

phpNamespaceTools.maximumSuggestions.description: Maximum number of relative-namespace suggestions per completion request.

phpNamespaceTools.updateNamespaceOnMove.description: Rewrite the namespace declaration of a PHP file when it is moved, so it keeps matching its composer PSR-4 directory. Imports of that class elsewhere are not updated.

phpNamespaceTools.maximumFilesPerMove.description: Refuse to update namespaces when a single move touches more PHP files than this. The refusal is reported in the PHP Namespace Tools output channel.
